subject: Filter() from dplyr without loading the whole dplyr package

messages.author: 4114912dbf9e2d36
messages.subject: Filter() from dplyr without loading the whole dplyr package
parts: I am currently using plyr, and I just want to use the filter() function of dplyr. Is there any way to get just that function without the whole dplyr package?

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: Filter() from dplyr without loading the whole dplyr package
parts:
If you don't want to load the whole thing, just reference the package:

dplyr::filter()

You still need the package installed though. 
B
